name: Centro Historico
tagline: Whitewashed colonial heart of the city
description: Popayan's famed White City core, a grid of whitewashed colonial buildings, churches and plazas around Parque Caldas. Walkable, safe by day, and home to cafes, universities, museums and most of the city's restaurants and cultural life.
bestFor: Nomads wanting walkable colonial charm, cafes, culture and central access to everything

name: El Recuerdo
description: A calm middle-class residential neighborhood north of the center, close to the Universidad del Cauca campus. Leafy streets, family homes and small local shops make it popular with students and longer-stay visitors seeking quiet away from tourist crowds.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a calm local neighborhood near universities and everyday amenities

name: La Pamba
description: A traditional working-class neighborhood just east of the historic center, known for its old church and authentic local feel. Affordable, close to the center on foot, and offering an unfiltered glimpse of everyday Popayan away from the tourist grid.
bestFor: Budget travellers wanting authentic local life within walking distance of the center

name: Modelo
description: A busy commercial and residential barrio just north of the historic center, with markets, banks, shops and bus connections. Practical and well-connected, it suits visitors who want everyday services and easy transport while staying close to the colonial core.
bestFor: Travellers prioritising services, markets and transport links near the center
